topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian selection of fitter clones driven by both genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and the cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of tissue stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and cell of origin in tumor initiation and progression using evidence from leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Role of the microenvironment, inflammation, and stroma in cancer growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma create permissive microenvironments that enable tumor outgrowth and provide therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes modern sequencing, transcriptomic, and computational techniques used to investigate tumor evolution and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multi-factor model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental interactions collectively drive the evolutionary process of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of the next session
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
